howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select one or more PDFs up to 500 MB each. Each page is exported with PyMuPDF's HTML exporter, which keeps the text, images and font styles.

howto.name: Download the HTML
howto.text: Click Convert. The result is a single self-contained HTML file with inline styles — open it in any browser without needing the PDF.

faq.a: Each line of text becomes a paragraph with its font, size, bold, italics and color set as inline styles, and the pages follow one another. The original positions are not applied, so lines stack one under another; drawn lines, boxes, vector charts and links are left out.
Yes. Embedded images come through as base64-encoded inline data URLs, so the HTML is fully self-contained — no external image files needed.
Web archiving, republishing offline documents online, reading a document in any browser without a PDF viewer, or any use where you need the content as a web page.
